definitions.explanation: Money paid to an employee for their work; compensation for employment.

examples.japanese: {給与|きゅうよ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧25⟦{日|にち}→日：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧。
examples.english: Salary is deposited on the 25th of every month.

examples.japanese: {給与|きゅうよ}⟦{明細|めいさい}→明細：06448_meisai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{給与|きゅうよ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My salary increased when I changed jobs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{給与|きゅうよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}している→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: The company is reviewing employee salaries.

examples.japanese: {給与|きゅうよ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれて→引く：01978_hiku⟧、⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{少|すく}なかった→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: After taxes and insurance were deducted from my salary, my take-home pay was less than I expected.

notes:
{給与|きゅうよ} is a formal term for salary or wages, commonly used in business and official contexts.

Common collocations:
- {給与|きゅうよ}{明細|めいさい} (pay slip, salary statement)
- {給与|きゅうよ}{所得|しょとく} (employment income)
- {給与|きゅうよ}を{上|あ}げる (to raise salary)
- {給与|きゅうよ}{体系|たいけい} (salary structure)
- {月|つき}{給与|きゅうよ} (monthly salary)

Related terms:
- {給料|きゅうりょう} (salary - more casual)
- {賃金|ちんぎん} (wages - often for hourly/daily work)
- {報酬|ほうしゅう} (compensation, remuneration)
- ボーナス (bonus)

{給与|きゅうよ} is more formal than {給料|きゅうりょう} and often used in official documents.
